The criterion holds: neither brief does anything on the must_not list. I checked both items across both briefs.

1. `npm run test:cli` appears nowhere, even though proof 6 in the issue uses it. Verifier Check 6 runs `npm test; echo "exit=$?"` and bases PASS on exit=0 from that. The builder's own self-check also uses "`npm test` exits 0".

2. The builder brief does not ask for a general separator option. It forbids one: "do not add --help, --sep or auto-detection". Its out-of-scope list also includes "a general --sep/--delimiter option". The only change it requests is a `--tsv` check that calls `parse(text, '\t')`.

The verifier mentions --sep/--delimiter only as advisory scope creep to note, and says those notes do not affect PASS/FAIL.
